subject: Post-call: Stakeholder map & next steps (FinPay)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kahn <samir.kahn@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Stakeholder map & next steps (FinPay)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps: 

Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: customer support routing + long-term plan to expand to knowledge base search.
- Expected QPS: ~30 concurrent sessions; target 200ms p50 latency for production.
- Decision timeline: vendor shortlist by ~Jul 20, final selection end of July.

Stakeholder map (as discussed):
- Champion: Rachel Kim (Customer Ops) — day-to-day owner
- Economic buyer: CFO (we think this is Priya Natarajan) — needs pricing/ROI
- Security & Legal: procurement + security review (SOC 2, network architecture)
- Procurement contact: Ayesha Rahman (you mentioned procurement owns vendor onboarding)

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached: FinPay_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf):
1) Provide procurement questionnaire + SOC2 snapshot — Redwood to send by Jul 3
2) Security review meeting — schedule week of Jul 5
3) Performance/POC plan — define success metrics (latency, accuracy) by Jul 10
4) Vendor review board — Jul 20 (you mentioned this date)

Asks for you: please confirm the economic buyer (Priya?), confirm procurement contact (Ayesha?), and share any internal scorecard/decision criteria you use.

Proposed next meeting: 30-min alignment + MAP review — Tue Jul 6 or Wed Jul 7. What works best?

Thanks — I’ll loop in Camila and our security lead to prepare the SOC2 snapshot and network diagram.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
@marissa

From: Samir Kahn <samir.kahn@finpay.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder map & next steps (FinPay)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side:
- Procurement contact is Ayesha Rahman (cc’d on this thread).
- Economic buyer is indeed our CFO, Priya Natarajan (I’ll intro you on the next thread once we have a short internal alignment).
- Vendor review board is tentatively scheduled for Tue Jul 20 — that’s the target date for vendor shortlist.

Procurement asks: we have a standard questionnaire I’ve attached (FinPay_Procurement_Questionnaire_Fillable.docx). Key items they’ll validate: data residency, retention, export controls, SOC 2 / ISO attestation, and subcontractor list. Procurement will want SOC 2 and a network diagram.

I’ll aim to get the internal scorecard for decision criteria by early next week but expect primary focus on: SLA/latency, total cost of ownership, data security posture, and evidence of reliable model quality (reranking/guardrails).

Can you confirm you can provide SOC2 snapshot and network diagram by Jul 7? Also can you populate the attached questionnaire and return by Jul 8 so procurement has time to review before their internal alignment next week.

Samir
Head of Platform Partnerships
FinPay

Attachment: FinPay_Procurement_Questionnaire_Fillable.docx

Appreciate the quick reply and the questionnaire. Confirming yes to the timeline — we’ll aim to get the SOC2 snapshot and network diagram to you by EOD Jul 7 and return the filled questionnaire by Jul 8.

I’ve attached an updated MAP (FinPay_MAP_v2.xlsx) with proposed milestone dates aligned to the vendor review board on Jul 20. High level we’ll own: SOC2 snapshot, architecture diagram, test dataset for initial POC, and a performance runbook.

Please confirm the following so we can finalize the MAP:
- Economic buyer: Priya Natarajan (confirmed?)

Happy to set the MAP review for Tue Jul 6 at 10:00am PT — I’ve proposed in the calendar (invite pending).

Thanks,
Marissa
